title: Prefetch on Hover
prompt:
Prefetch a detail query when the user hovers a link, so the navigation feels instant.

**Requirements:**
1. Import `useQueryClient` from `@tanstack/react-query`.
2. Define and export `type Article = { id: number; title: string; body: string }`.
3. Define and export `fetchArticle(id: number): Promise<Article>` -- GET `/api/articles/<id>`.
4. Export a function component `ArticleLink({ id, label }: { id: number; label: string })` that renders an `<a>` whose `onMouseEnter` calls `queryClient.prefetchQuery({ queryKey: ['article', id], queryFn: () => fetchArticle(id) })`.
hints: `prefetchQuery` warms the cache without subscribing -- the next `useQuery` reads from cache instantly.
Mirror `onMouseEnter` with `onFocus` so keyboard users get the same prefetch.
Use the same `queryKey` shape as the destination's `useQuery` -- otherwise the prefetched data won't be picked up.
